prompts.title: Archangel City Destruction Video Prompt – Bystander Smartphone Footage & Telekinetic Shockwave
prompts.description: A one-shot video prompt in the style of bystander smartphone footage: a winged archangel hovers between skyscrapers and unleashes a telekinetic pressure wave that shatters windows and blows transformers, while the crowd panics and shaky handheld zooms capture the chaos.

prompts.title: Prompt 1 · Video
prompts.text:
Use the provided image as the opening frame of one continuous, unedited bystander smartphone recording.
The winged man hangs high between the skyscrapers as strong gusts whip his long hair, shredded black robe and individual wing feathers. He turns his head toward the street, draws his arms inward, then violently thrusts both hands outward.
The handheld phone camera shakily zooms toward him, struggling to keep focus. A massive telekinetic pressure wave erupts from his body, visibly compressing the fog and blasting outward through the city canyon.
Build on the destruction already visible: glass windows rupture in fast cascading rows across both building facades, shards and masonry burst outward and fall under gravity, electrical wires whip, and several pole-mounted transformers arc, spark and explode in succession, sending brief orange flashes through the smoke. The camera operator recoils and rapidly zooms back out to capture the spreading devastation.
The crowd reacts continuously and individually: people flinch, scream, duck, stumble backward and scatter while others keep filming with trembling phones, heads tracking the winged figure and the exploding transformers. Wind drives smoke, dust and loose feathers across the view, and debris falls toward the street.
End in a wide, badly shaken street-level view with the man still hovering above the chaos, his wings flexing against the wind.
Authentic low-light phone exposure, natural motion blur, slight autofocus hunting, imperfect digital zoom and microphone distortion. Real-time action, one uninterrupted shot, no cinematic cuts.
Audio: violent wind, a low pressure boom, sharp glass breaks, crackling electricity, panicked voices and distant sirens; no music.
